DELL.text: Free cash flow was $8.6 billion in FY2026: operating cash flow of $11.2 billion less capital spending of $2.6 billion (computed from two filed figures). That is 7.5% of revenue. In FY2021 it was $9.3 billion.
Stock-based compensation was $723 million in FY2026, 0.6% of revenue, against 1.7% in FY2021.
In FY2026 the company paid $6 billion to repurchase its own shares and $1.5 billion in dividends: $7.5 billion together (computed from two filed figures).
In the three months ended 2026-07-31 revenue was $47 billion, up 57.7% from $29.8 billion in the three months ended 2025-08-01.
Over the four quarters to 2026-07-31 revenue added up to $151 billion (computed from five filed figures), operating income to $14.3 billion and net income to $11.4 billion.
Free cash flow over the same four quarters was $8.6 billion: operating cash flow of $12.2 billion less capital spending of $3.6 billion (computed from ten filed figures).

The proxy statement filed 2026-05-15 gives the principal executive officer’s total pay for FY2026 as $3.4 million in its summary compensation table, and the “compensation actually paid” - the SEC’s measure, which revalues share awards over the year - as $3.4 million.
For the other named executive officers the same table gives an average of $38.2 million in total and $33.2 million actually paid.
The table puts the value of $100 held in the company’s shares over the years it covers at $339.99 at the end of FY2026, and $256.43 for the peer group the company chose.

Remaining performance obligations - revenue under contract that was not yet recognised - were $82 billion at the end of FY2026, against $38 billion a year earlier. That is 72.2% of FY2026 revenue (computed from two filed figures).
Deferred revenue was $26.9 billion at the end of FY2026 (tagged ContractWithCustomerLiability), against $26 billion a year earlier.
The latest annual report gives the workforce as 97,000 in its own words. FY2026 revenue works out to about $1.2 million for each (computed from one filed figure and the number in that sentence).

At the end of FY2026 the balance sheet carried $11.5 billion in cash and cash equivalents, and $31.5 billion of debt as tagged (LongTermDebtNoncurrent + DebtCurrent). Debt less cash was $20 billion (computed from three filed figures).
